grape-stomping.name: grape-stomping
notes: Original knee-down schematic informed by Brotherhood Winery event photograph of bare feet in grape-filled open wooden tubs. Feet contact the grape surface, equal lower-leg lengths, no unseen upper-body anatomy implied. Purple grapes distinguish from warm wood and skin; no arrow or costume copied.

latte-art.name: latte-art
notes: Original broad ceramic cup with handle attached at upper and lower sidewall, recessed coffee surface and flat milk heart. Schematic proportions; no floating pitcher, imaginary liquid stream, exact cup brand or recipe promised. Joe Coffee curriculum explicitly teaches milk steaming and free-pour hearts.
